limitations: This is full-dwell evidence-conditioned coverage, not one continuous 60 s Kalman trajectory. Multiple CFO branches coexist and V3 requires a fresh call at each caller-qualified continuity arc.
The 537 windows are bounded Standard trajectory samples, not a uniform tiling of every raw sample. GLRT20ms supplies uniform 25 ms-cadence context over the full dwell.
The per-window independent frame-CFO line is an internal consistency reference, not external Doppler truth.
